title: Smart Moves With Unexpected Inheritance

scenes.text: Got a $75,000 inheritance? Here’s the smartest first step
Pay off any high‑interest debt first; rates above 6% cost more than most investment returns
scenes.label: ELIMINATE HIGH‑INTEREST DEBT
scenes.query: high interest debt payoff priority inheritance
scenes.query2: pay off credit card debt before investing

scenes.text: Set aside a tax‑free emergency fund of three to six months of expenses before any other use
scenes.label: EMERGENCY FUND FIRST
scenes.query: emergency fund three to six months guidelines
scenes.query2: how much cash reserve should I keep

scenes.text: Invest the remaining amount in a diversified low‑cost index fund to capture long‑term market growth
scenes.label: INDEX FUND INVESTMENT
scenes.query: low cost index fund for inheritance

scenes.text: Follow for the money mindset they don't teach you.
scenes.query: follow wealth building tips call to action

description: An unexpected inheritance can be a game‑changer if you handle it right. Prioritize debt, secure an emergency cushion, then let low‑cost index funds work for you. Follow for more wealth‑building tips.
